verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents dozens of prebuilt connectors for shopping carts, billing systems, ERPs and accounting platforms. You authorize one once from Data Sources and Kintsugi keeps transactions in sync, which covers the core of no-plumbing ingestion. Payment processors are never named among the connector categories, and no specific platforms or maintenance details appear. Missing for 10: explicit payment-processor connectors, a named list of supported billing/commerce platforms, evidence of how connectors are maintained, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, there are maintained integrations for my revenue stack — billing systems, payment processors, and commerce platforms feed transactions in without me building the plumbing

citations.quote: Dozens of prebuilt connectors cover shopping carts, billing systems, ERPs, and accounting platforms. Pick your platform, authorize it once, and Kintsugi keeps transactions in sync from then on.
Open Data Sources in the app and click Connect, then choose the route that matches your stack.
